scratch.description: A blank agent. You choose the model, tools and knowledge.

setup.install: An admin installs it in Bridge

editor.title: Agent
editor.description: Instructions, model, tools, knowledge, Guard rules, tests and publishing.

empty.title: Nothing to edit yet
empty.description: The editor opens here once the agent loads.

descriptionField.label: Description
descriptionField.help: What people see when they pick the agent.

briefing.title: Instructions
briefing.description: Write it like you'd brief a new teammate: what the agent does, what it should never do, and how to hand over to a person.
briefing.label: Instructions
briefing.placeholder: You help customers with orders and refunds. Be brief and kind. If a refund is above $500, hand over to a person.

starters.title: Conversation starters
starters.description: Suggestions people can tap to begin a conversation. Up to 6.

preview.label: Preview
preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the agent looks in Chat.

model.title: Model
model.description: Only models you're allowed to use are listed.
model.label: Model

auto.label: Auto
auto.soon: Picks the best model for each task. Coming soon.

unavailable.title: Model removed by an admin
unavailable.description: Choose another model. Until you publish, the live version keeps answering with its fallback.

creativity.label: Creativity
creativity.help: Low is precise and repeatable. High is varied and inventive.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: How the agent checks itself, and what happens to private conversations.

doubleCheck.label: AI double-check model
doubleCheck.help: Reviews risky actions before a person is asked.

fallback.label: Use the Vault fallback order
fallback.help: Private conversations fall back to local models only.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: APIs and MCP servers the agent may use, and what each may do. Tools start read only.

empty.title: No tools yet
empty.description: Add an API or an MCP server so the agent can look things up or act. Tools start read only.

connection.empty: No accounts you can use yet

row.addApprovalRule: Add an approval rule in Guard

apiDialog.description: The agent sends this request when it needs what the API knows or does.

name.label: Name
name.help: What you and the agent call this tool, for example “Order lookup”.
name.taken: Another tool already has this name.

purpose.label: When should the agent use it?
purpose.help: Tells the agent what the tool is for.

url.label: Address
url.invalid: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.

changesData.title: {method} changes data on the other side
changesData.description: The tool starts read only. Choose Ask first or Can act in the list when it should be allowed to.

connection.label: Account
connection.help: The account the request signs in with. Keys and tokens belong in a connection, not in headers.

headers.label: Headers
headers.help: Public headers only, such as an API version.
headers.name: Header {number} name
headers.invalid: Use letters, numbers and hyphens only.

inputSchema.label: Arguments
inputSchema.help: Optional. A JSON Schema of what the agent fills in for each call.
inputSchema.invalid: Enter a JSON object, or leave this empty.

test.help: Sends the request now with the arguments below and shows the answer. Nothing is saved.

test.truncated: Only the start of the answer is shown.

mcpDialog.description: The agent can use the actions this server offers.

name.label: Name
name.help: What you and the agent call this server, for example “Company wiki”.
name.taken: Another tool already has this name.

purpose.label: When should the agent use it?
purpose.help: Tells the agent what the server is for.

url.label: Server address
url.invalid: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.

connection.label: Account
connection.help: The account the server signs in with. An open server needs a connection with no sign-in.

actions.title: Actions
actions.help: Find what the server offers, then turn actions off or give them their own permission.

bases.title: Knowledge bases
bases.description: The agent searches these to answer. You can add the bases you manage.

empty.description: Add a knowledge base so the agent can search and cite it.

knowledge.sourceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}

unavailable.name: Knowledge base unavailable
unavailable.description: It was deleted, or you can no longer see it.

add.empty: No more knowledge bases to add

cite.label: Cite sources
cite.help: Show which documents an answer came from.

only.label: Only answer from knowledge
only.help: When the knowledge has no answer, say so instead of guessing.

inherited.title: From Guard
inherited.description: What the organization already decides for every agent. This agent can be stricter, never looser.
inherited.loadError: Couldn't load the organization's Guard rules
inherited.noRules: No organization or team rules besides the thresholds.

thresholds.name: Confidence thresholds
thresholds.value: Automatic from {auto}% · AI double-check from {review}% · below that a person decides

thresholds.title: Thresholds for this agent
thresholds.description: How sure the agent must be before it acts on its own. Yours can match the organization's or be higher.

auto.label: Automatic from
auto.help: At or above this, the agent acts without anyone looking.

review.label: AI double-check from
review.help: Between the two values a second AI checks the action. Below, a person decides.

thresholds.floor: The organization's thresholds ({auto}% and {review}%) are the lowest this agent can use.
thresholds.result: This agent acts on its own from {auto}%, gets a double-check from {review}% and asks a person below that.

outdated.title: Lower than the organization's now
outdated.description: The organization raised its thresholds. Its values apply to this agent until you raise yours.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.description: Actions that need a person to say yes first.

empty.title: No approval rules for this agent
empty.description: The organization's rules still apply. Add one to ask a person before a specific action.

suggest.title: {tool} can act on its own
suggest.description: Tools that can act should have an approval rule, so a person decides first.

ruleDialog.description: A person has to approve this action before the agent takes it.

action.label: Action
action.help: The tool or action, like Refund API or payments.refund.

wait.label: Stop waiting after a while
wait.help: Without a limit the action waits until someone decides.
wait.invalid: Enter a whole number, up to 30 days.

blocked.title: Blocked actions
blocked.description: Actions this agent never takes, whatever else allows them.
blocked.empty: Nothing is blocked for this agent.

add.label: Block an action
add.help: The tool or action, like Delete record or payments.refund.

channels.description: Where the agent answers. A new channel goes live when you publish; a live one changes at once.

exposure.api: Anyone with a key that can run agents can get answers from {names}. There is no signed-in person on the API, so the agent uses its own knowledge and tools.
exposure.widget: Anyone using the website widget can get answers from {names}. There is no signed-in person on the widget, so the agent uses its own knowledge and tools.
exposure.slack: Anyone who can message the agent in Slack can get answers from {names}. The agent uses its own knowledge and tools, not each person's.
exposure.whatsapp: Anyone who messages the WhatsApp number can get answers from {names}. The agent uses its own knowledge and tools.
exposure.nothing: The agent has no knowledge or tools, so it answers from the model alone.

queued.request: When you publish, an admin is asked to approve publishing to {channel}. The rest goes live meanwhile.

chat.name: SurefyOS chat

notPublished.description: The API answers only for a published agent.

paused.title: This agent is paused
paused.description: The API doesn't answer while the agent is paused.

archived.description: The API doesn't answer for an archived agent.
